scope: Bounded source-to-site semantic closure for every currently explicit MM1-linked spell owner plus Sleep, Invisible Stalker, and additional implicit MM1-profile dependencies discovered in spell text/reference screening. This does not claim Monster Manual profile-catalog completeness.

method.sourceFirst: Read source page pixels; mapped printed folio against PDF ordinal; then compare scoped claim with current captured sourceRecord, rendered DOM detail and public search text.
method.pixelReview: 216 dpi private PyMuPDF full-page renders. Each source image was inspected in a separate view result with its printed folio visible. Filename page mapping alone is not evidence.
method.interpretation: Classifications name an exact target surface. A cited source page, matching heading, or lexically matching search term alone is not a semantic pass. Full monster-stat profiles remain an explicit current product-feature boundary, not a permanent user prohibition.
method.siteSnapshotCaveat: The snapshot records direct routes and public-search self-matches but does not open any source viewer; this assessment makes no claim that source chips were activated.

assessments.classificationTarget: PHB rebellion check versus MM lost-concentration resolution
assessments.sourceFinding: PHB p.79 represents the 5% rebellion check at the end of the second and each succeeding round, regardless of concentration. MM p.37 separately resolves a failure to concentrate: 75% turns on the summoning party and attacks; 25% does not turn and immediately returns to its plane. PHB 5% and MM 75/25 have different triggers, so there is no printed contradiction or precedence ruling to invent.

currentCheckpoint.meaning: These are independent identity/join axes. The 223 TOC labels are not a profile count; 305 repository rows are not the source denominator.

knownPartialPhysicalHeadingWork.meaning: These bounded labels do not constitute all Monster Manual subprofiles or stat blocks.

mainAndSubprofileDenominatorPlan.remainingDenominator: The actual number of unique main stat profiles, distinct subprofiles/variants, and separately countable shared-profile rules remains unknown; no percent coverage can be computed yet.
closurePlan: Traverse the entire Monster Manual source page sequence (all 114 PDF pages) and segment every profile-heading/stat block, internal variant/subprofile, shared family table, note, qualifier, continuation paragraph and cross-page continuation before consulting monsters.json for joins.

Record one source-first row per physical profile/stat block and an independent row for profile variants whose attack, defense or other mechanics differ; record family-level shared prose/tables once with explicit member scope. Separate aliases/headings that point to an existing profile from genuinely distinct stat-bearing forms.
For each source unit record printed folio, PDF ordinal, page-image SHA, exact content boundaries and continuation; reconcile page backreferences so no page or column segment is silently omitted.

After the physical denominator is closed, join each profile by source identity to all 305 current MM data rows and all 223 TOC main labels; preserve the 222 alias/title joins and the Centipede, Giant p.14 missing locator as independent repository/source-index evidence.

Only then compare all enumerated profile stat fields, prose procedures, tables, qualifiers and variant-specific exceptions against exact site fields/DOM/search; report profile identity, stat-block coverage and detailed fact coverage as separate denominators.

remainingScopedUncertainty: Enumerate the exact MM profile set that the PHB Sleep spell excludes; current pass confirms the PHB cross-reference and current card statement but does not claim an exhaustive immunity list.
Resolve the variable runtime target policy for Gate, Spiritwrack and Shape Change; do not guess an MM page before target identity is fixed.
Public source-chip opening/region behavior was not tested by the pinned snapshot and is outside this semantic source-match closure.

MM p.37 states a general limit of one conjuring per day per means per elemental type and only one controlled elemental at a time. The three PHB Magic-user/Druid card summaries do not state these constraints; the exact mapping of per means to distinct spell entries remains open. This is a bounded interpretation question, separate from the resolved PHB 5% versus MM 75%/25% triggers.
